name: Sticker Story
summary: Dress a story card with draggable stickers, then share it into your story ring or save a PNG
about: A 9:16 story editor with a travel photo, a caption and eight hand-drawn stickers. Tap a sticker and it peels off the tray, flies over and slaps onto the card; drag it around, turn it or drop it on the bin. Share to story lifts the card, morphs it into a circle that flies into your avatar while the ring fills, and Save renders a real 1080 x 1920 picture.
how: Edit the caption and pick one of four backgrounds; the new one wipes in as a circle.
Tap stickers in the tray to add them (up to eight).
Drag a sticker to move it, or drop it on the bin. With a sticker focused, arrow keys move it, R turns it and Delete removes it.
Press Share to story to post it into the stories row with a progress ring.
Press Save to download the card as my-story.png.
